# Top Navigation Bar

Top Navigation Bar is a native component provided by SeaTalk Client, it serves three functions to our user:

1. Let SOP App users know where they are
2. Provide basic navigation actions
3. Provide entrance to App Menu which holds extra action buttons for an SOP App

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Customizability

Currently, you can customize the "Page Title" section of your top navigation bar through our (TBD) SDK API

* For Web App:[https://open.seatalk.io/docs/web-set-navigation-bar](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/web-set-navigation-bar)
* For RN App:[https://open.seatalk.io/docs/rn-Set-Navigation-Bar](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/rn-Set-Navigation-Bar)
